Markus / Priya — thanks for the context. I reviewed Redwood_MSA_v3-redline.docx and added comments focused on the procurement/portal gating items. High-level guidance below, and I attached a short registration playbook draft that your onboarding team can use.

Key redline items I flagged (summary):
- Payment terms: confirm if AsterBio requires NET30 vs NET45; adjust order form to reflect the agreed option and include clear invoice submission instructions.
- PO acknowledgement: keep 48h as default, but include explicit carve-out for system outages and scheduled maintenance; acceptance = system ack + human fallback process.
- Data retention/logging: add a short clause confirming retention of order/tracking logs for 18 months to support PO reconciliation audits (APAC customers often request this).
- EDI testing: require signed test plan (simple checklist) before moving to production; include contact details for Redwood's EDI ops.
- VAT/reseller ID: allow vendor-supplied fields but require documentation upload (tax certificate) during registration — playbook includes required docs.

Registration playbook items (attached Registration_Playbook_v1.md) — excerpt: 
- Mandatory fields: legal name, tax_id/VAT, remit address, primary AP contact, invoice delivery method, PO acknowledgement email
- Optional but recommended: reseller/VAT certificate, secondary billing contact, EDI endpoint details
- Gating: MSA signed OR legal exception approved; test EDI pass; sample invoice accepted by AP team

Attachments:
- Registration_Playbook_v1.md (Markdown)

Priya — if that looks good I can incorporate any AsterBio-specific notes and sign off on the playbook. Marissa, please take the lead on mapping the Coupa fields from the spreadsheet to AsterBio's vendor form and schedule the sandbox EDI test.
